data_deps.name: image_deshadow_istd
data_deps.description: REAL shadow / shadow-free / mask 64x64 image triplets for the deshadow-* image shadow-removal tasks, in THREE cast-shadow severity settings (light/medium/heavy). Triplets come from ISTD (Wang, Li & Yang, 'Stacked Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks for Jointly Learning Shadow Detection and Shadow Removal', CVPR 2018; pulled via the Donghyun99/ISTD HF-mirror parquet re-host), which captures the SAME static outdoor scene TWICE (with and without a real cast shadow), so the target (shadow-free) image is an authentic photograph of the true unshadowed scene, not a synthetic composite. Each 640x480 triplet is center-cropped to 480x480 then resized to 64x64. Severities are terciles of each triplet's MEASURED shadow attenuation ratio (mean brightness of the shadow image over the shadow-free target, restricted to the masked shadow pixels), pooled across ISTD's official train+test split; train/val within each severity reuse ISTD's own disjoint-scene split (1330/540 triplets) so held-out PSNR still measures real cross-scene generalisation. All deterministic given the seed.
